info.name: JFrog Connect REST API
info.description:
API for managing IoT and edge devices, deploying over-the-air software updates, and monitoring device fleets at scale. JFrog Connect (formerly Upswift) provides a comprehensive platform for managing Linux-based IoT and edge devices.

Contact Support:
 Name: JFrog
